# aikido_custom_sast_rule (Resource)

Manages a custom SAST rule: a semgrep rule Aikido runs on every code repository scan, raising an issue with the given title, summary and fix instructions for each match. Custom rules require a Pro plan or higher; free and trial workspaces are limited to 5 rules. The API client needs the custom_sast_rules:read and custom_sast_rules:write scopes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The rule id inside semgrep_rule is replaced by Aikido with CUSTOM-RULE-<id>,
# so any id works. Trailing newlines are removed before sending, so a heredoc
# can be used as-is.
resource "aikido_custom_sast_rule" "no_eval" {
  issue_title = "Avoid eval()"
  tldr        = "eval() runs arbitrary code, so attacker-controlled input leads to code execution."
  how_to_fix  = "Parse the input with JSON.parse() or a dedicated parser instead of evaluating it."
  language    = "JS"
  priority    = 80

  semgrep_rule = <<-EOT
    rules:
      - id: no-eval
        message: Avoid eval()
        languages: [javascript, typescript]
        severity: ERROR
        pattern: eval(...)
  EOT
}

# Keeping rules as files makes them easy to test with the semgrep CLI.
resource "aikido_custom_sast_rule" "no_shell_true" {
  issue_title  = "subprocess called with shell=True"
  tldr         = "shell=True passes the command through a shell, allowing command injection."
  how_to_fix   = "Pass the command as a list of arguments and drop shell=True."
  language     = "PY"
  priority     = 60
  semgrep_rule = file("${path.module}/rules/no-shell-true.yaml")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `how_to_fix` (String) Instructions for fixing the issue, shown on each issue this rule raises.
- `issue_title` (String) Title of the issues this rule raises.
- `language` (String) Language the rule targets. Case-sensitive; one of JS, TS, PHP, Java, Scala, GO, PY, Ruby, .NET, RUST, Dart, Swift, Elixir, C, Clojure, kotlin, terraform, VB, yaml, generic.
- `priority` (Number) Priority of the issues this rule raises, from 1 to 100.
- `semgrep_rule` (String) The semgrep rule, in YAML. It must define a single rule: the first line must be exactly `rules:`, every other line must be indented, and the rule needs id, message, languages, severity and a pattern. Trailing newlines and Windows line endings are removed before sending, so heredocs and file() work as-is. Aikido replaces the rule id with CUSTOM-RULE-<id>; the provider accounts for that, so it causes no diff.
- `tldr` (String) Short explanation of the issue, shown on each issue this rule raises.

### Read-Only

- `has_error` (Boolean) Whether an Aikido scan failed on this rule since it was last saved. Saving the rule clears it until the next scan.
- `id` (String) Aikido custom rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Custom rules are imported by their Aikido custom rule ID, listed by the
# aikido_custom_sast_rules data source. The imported semgrep_rule carries
# Aikido's CUSTOM-RULE-<id> rule id, so a configuration using its own rule id
# shows one update on the first plan after import.
terraform import aikido_custom_sast_rule.no_eval 123
```
